scope: Distinct standby/thinking visuals, viewport assembly/disassembly, opt-in synthesized audio and workbench visual entry/leave. No native tray shutdown animation.

automated.javascript_syntax: node --check passed for logo.js, preview.js, sound.js and lifecycle.js

checks: Standby: halo and stable meter pulse; scan opacity zero
Thinking: four animated regions, 2.4s scan, 1.8s pulse, staggered meter and PROCESSING label
Pause freezes scan pseudo-element, all four regions and meter; paused intro uses short static fallback
Nine-part modal fills 1280x720 and 390x844 viewport; controls remain inside viewport
Sound opt-in unlocks AudioContext and button reflects enabled state; no browser audio exceptions observed
Boot demo closes automatically and restores focus; exit demo skip removes modal
Workbench opens with boot sequence once per tab/instance; refreshing same instance does not repeat
Workbench leave completes into return screen; return restores unsent draft unchanged
New-session reconstruction keeps one surface and four processing segments per logo
Escape skips sequence and clears modal flag
No console warning/error observed in preview or workbench
Eight served brand assets match current disk bytes
Approved master, core export, PNG icon and ICO hashes unchanged
Runtime remains standby with zero active model requests after visual leave test
Final preview meter bottom 570.89px remains above hint top 587.98px

motion_design.pointer_updates: event-driven; at most one queued requestAnimationFrame per interactive logo
motion_design.timers: one bounded completion timer per cinematic sequence; cleared on skip/close
motion_design.audio: local Web Audio; opt-in, conservative gain and compressor, finite scheduled sources, cancellation generation guard

limits: Native Windows desktop/tray shutdown sequence not implemented; direct tab closure cannot guarantee animation
Autoplay remains browser-restricted; fresh pages may require sound unlock
OS reduced-motion setting and physical touch input not exercised
Audio output scheduled and UI state verified; acoustic loudness and listening quality not independently measured
Raster source artwork; no SVG master
